edges.reason: claimAndUnstake calls claimZombie before unstaking.
claimAndUnstake performs external ERC721 transferFrom while iterating staked ids.
claimAndUnstake reads tokenIdToYield to gate unstaking.
claimAndUnstake reads tokenIdToStaker to verify original staker.
claimAndUnstake uses msg.sender for staker equality checks.
claimAndMove calls claimZombie first.
claimAndMove restarts digging time via initDigTime.
claimAndMove checks tokenIdToYield before moving.
claimAndMove compares ownerOf and stakers with msg.sender.
stakeByIds calls external transferFrom inside the stake loop.
stakeByIds calls initDigTime at the end.
stakeByIds validates msg.sender ownership of grave and tokens.
claimZombie compares tokenIdToTargetTime against block.timestamp.
claimZombie mints externally before marking the grave yielded and burning.
claimZombie performs _transfer to dead address which triggers transfer hooks.
claimZombie writes tokenIdToYield to true after minting.
claimZombie requires ownerOf equals msg.sender.
claimZombies loops calling claimZombie.
fastenDigging calls external burnFrom inside the loop before updating dig time.
fastenDigging subtracts a fixed amount from tokenIdToTargetTime.
fastenDigging burns miece from msg.sender.
mintGrave generates the hash via hash().
mintGrave calls external burnFrom to charge the mint price.
mintGrave starts the digging timer for early graves.
mintGrave reads and writes katzIdUsedForMint.
mintGrave checks totalSupply against MAX_SUPPLY.
mintGrave mints to and burns from msg.sender.
mintReserve is guarded by onlyOwner.
mintReserve calls hash for each reserved grave.
mintReserve calls initDigTime for each grave.
setContractAddresses is guarded by onlyOwner.
addTraitType is guarded by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner compares stored _owner.
onlyOwner compares caller msg.sender to _owner.
initDigTime derives target time from block.timestamp.
initDigTime writes tokenIdToTargetTime.
hash mixes block.timestamp into the random seed.
hash increments and reads SEED_NONCE.
hash checks hashToMinted for collisions.
_tokenIdToHash overrides hash based on tokenIdToYield.

normalization_plan.reason: graveId only parameterizes the grave identified in claimAndUnstake.
tokenIds only parameterizes the staking loop of stakeByIds.
tokenId only parameterizes the claim logic in claimZombie.
_times only bounds the mint loop in mintReserve.
_totalSupply is a temporary cache of totalSupply inside mintGrave.
thisTokenId is the derived new id used only inside mintGrave.
katzId is consumed only by the mint verification logic of mintGrave.
